description: Global daily ELSE_GPCC runoff in annual NetCDF files
data_source: ELSE_GPCC runoff product associated with Kim et al. (2009)
access_notes: Separate cmf_v5_package_data/inp/ELSE_GPCC store; local copies are Git-ignored. Former ELSE_GPCC_nc directory renamed by maintainer. Redistribution conditions remain unconfirmed.
notes: Maintainer reports annual files for 1979-2010. Header-only inspection of runoff2000.nc confirms 366 time records, latitude=180, longitude=360, float32 runoff(time,latitude,longitude), mm day-1, missing_value=-999 and daily time bounds. Grid settings derive from the existing global source specification; coordinate values, data values and model ingestion were not validated in this rename task. The former Binary directory was removed; Binary extraction scripts require a separately configured source.

description: Minimal Mekong daily runoff in monthly Binary files for mek01
data_source: Regional extraction from annual inp/ELSE_GPCC/runoff2000.nc using inp/tools/extract_ELSE_GPCC.py
access_notes: Two monthly Binary files tracked by Git; global NetCDF comes from optional additional-data store.
distribution_scope: repository-tracked sample; distribution package included; redistribution approved by maintainer
notes: 20x30 grid, NtoS, little-endian float32, missing=-999. CROFFREQ=MON; each record is a daily field with no averaging. Reuses map/mekong_15min/inpmat_test-mek_1deg.bin and matching dimension file. All 60 fields match global NetCDF slices and former daily Binary files exactly. Format/extraction checks do not establish scientific correctness. mek01 retains its 40-day run interval.

description: Japan hourly 6min runoff, aggregated from TE-japan 1min sample
data_source: Today's Japan 1-arcmin simulation output (Yoshimura Laboratory), spatially aggregated to 6 arcmin for CaMa-Flood
access_notes: Derived from the existing test_jpn_1hr sample. Original Today's Japan simulation output provided by Yoshimura Laboratory; redistribution permission obtained. Reproduce using inp/test-jpn_6min_1hr/s01-aggregate_runoff.sh.
distribution_scope: repository-tracked compact sample; redistribution permission confirmed by maintainer
notes: 6x6 latitude-dependent spherical-area-weighted spatial mean; original hourly values and temporal order retained without unit conversion. The maintainer identifies the original source CTL mm/day label as erroneous and assesses the values as mm/hour, consistent with gosh/test3; this physical interpretation was not independently verified. Source blocks containing any -9999 are output as -9999; inspected source has no missing cells. Technical conservation and format checks do not independently validate source runoff science.

description: Global daily 15min Earth2Observe/ECMWF WRR2 runoff sample
data_source: eartH2Observe WRR2; ECMWF HTESSEL runoff product
access_notes: Available only in the separate CaMa-Flood v4.30 distribution package NetCDF global attributes describe WRR2 and ECMWF HTESSEL; no direct original download URL is established by the file metadata, and its references attribute says "to be defined".
notes: The NetCDF header declares a 0.25-degree grid, descending latitude, and units mm day-1. Its license attribute refers to ODbL; no separate source-data URL is recorded in the inspected package files. gosh/test2-conus_06min_netcdf.sh sets IFRQ_INP=24 and DROFUNIT=86400000. Scientific validation was not performed.

description: ERA5-Land Japan sample in CaMa-Flood NetCDF format
data_source: Existing ERA5-Land Japan sample; maintained NetCDF converter: inp/download_ERA5-Land/convert_CMF_nc.py
access_notes: Existing source and converted sample relocated without regeneration; datasets and logs are now Git-ignored. Run sample-japan_1month.sh only after reviewing CDS access and settings.
distribution_scope: Local generated sample; ignored by Git; redistribution requires review
notes: File metadata declares units=mm, 24-hour accumulated depth, time=31 daily labels, and fill value 1e20. The unit conversion yields DROFUNIT=86400000. Timestamp labels retain the source dataset convention; first-record accumulation handling and scientific values have not been independently validated. Relocated from ERA5-Land_download/ERA5land-jpn_nc; historical metadata checks are retained, with no new scientific or real-download validation. KG-0019 remains open.

description: Two-day sample global ERA5-Land runoff NetCDF for direct input
data_source: ERA5-Land global runoff downloaded from the Copernicus Climate Data Store
access_notes: Historical global source metadata; new destination is planned by sample-global_2day.sh. No new download or converted global sample was generated in this reorganization. Git-ignored.
distribution_scope: External CDS source; sample not tracked or distributed
notes: Downloaded on 2026-11-02 using the configured CDS API, 24-hour timestep, global domain. Observed NetCDF: ro(valid_time,latitude,longitude), float32, units=m, GRIB_stepType=accum, _FillValue=NaN; 2 time records, 1801 decreasing latitude values 90 to -90, 3600 longitude values -180 to 179.9 at 0.1 degree. Source structure matches the model NetCDF reader when CVNTIME=valid_time and CVNROF=ro. DROFUNIT=86400 is the dimensional conversion for m per 24-hour record, conditional on the source accumulation interpretation. This check does not validate runoff science or first/last accumulation attribution. Directory and grouping now follow the new global sample wrapper; historical grid metadata are not verification of a newly requested product. Converted output is not registered as verified.

description: Long-term Mekong daily NetCDF runoff extracted from global ELSE_GPCC
data_source: Annual global inp/ELSE_GPCC/runoffYYYY.nc; regional extraction via inp/tools/extract_ELSE_GPCC.py
access_notes: Regional repository sample; 32 annual files generated locally, pending Git staging/review. Global source supplied as optional additional data.
distribution_scope: Repository sample; regional redistribution scope retained; package assembly planned.
notes: 32 annual files, 11688 daily records; float32 runoff(time,latitude,longitude), mm day-1, missing=-999, CF proleptic_gregorian time/bounds. Longitude centers 90.5..109.5E; latitude 34.5..5.5N. NetCDF-4 deflate=3 with shuffle. All regional values compared exactly to global NetCDF. Existing 2000-2005 files retained after equivalence checks. Use CROFFREQ=YEAR and INPMAT_TAG=test-mek_1deg for the unchanged map input matrix. No new model regression or independent scientific validation performed.
